data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure (Wikipedia infobox, then timeanddate time, then a Notes entry) and has the right parameters and order. It deviates slightly: it records the capital from the infobox, adds a time zone to the note, omits the explicit "New note" click, and uses the World Clock search instead of typing and pressing Enter. These are minor gaps that a builder could fill, and a few UI details are vague.
